faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Govt ITI Karanjia Guest Instructor posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 17th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the institute before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Part-Time Guest Instructor position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Part-Time Guest Instructor position is Rs. 150 to Rs. 200 per hour, based on the specific trade and qualifications.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Part-Time Guest Instructor role?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Part-Time Guest Instructor position, with one vacancy each for Fitter, Electrician, and Dress Making trades.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 38 years for all the advertised posts.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Fitter post?
faq.answer: For the Fitter post, candidates need a B.Voc/Degree in Mechanical Engineering, a 3-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, or an NTC/NAC in Fitter trade.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Guest Instructor positions?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting, a written test, a practical test, a computer test, a viva-voce, evaluation of technical experience, and assessment of pedagogical skills.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for the Govt ITI Karanjia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply through email by sending their complete application along with necessary documents.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Government Industrial Training Institute Karanjia located?
faq.answer: Government Industrial Training Institute Karanjia is located in Karanjia, Odisha, with the pincode 757037.

faq.question: Q10. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Part-Time Guest Instructor positions will be conducted on 20th August 2026.
